const job = $json ?? {};


// --------------------------------------------------
// 1. CANDIDATE CV
// --------------------------------------------------

const cvNode =
  $('Extract CV Text').first().json ?? {};


const rawCvText =
  cvNode.text ??
  cvNode.content ??
  cvNode.data ??
  cvNode.extractedText ??
  '';


const cvText =
  String(rawCvText)
    .replace(/\r/g, '')
    .replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();


// --------------------------------------------------
// 2. JOB DESCRIPTION
// --------------------------------------------------

const description =
  String(
    job.description ?? ''
  )
    .replace(/\r/g, '')
    .replace(/[ \t]+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
    .trim();


// --------------------------------------------------
// 3. AI PROMPT
// --------------------------------------------------

const aiPrompt = `
Use ONLY the job data provided below.

Do not browse the web.
Do not use external information.
Do not invent missing information.

You have TWO tasks:

1. Complete missing structured job fields ONLY when the answer
   can be reliably supported by the job title, description,
   criteria or already extracted job data.

2. Evaluate the technical/professional MATCH between the job
   and the candidate CV.


==================================================
GENERAL STRUCTURED FIELD RULES
==================================================

IMPORTANT:

- Preserve every field that is already populated.
- Only complete fields that are currently empty.
- Never replace a populated parser value.
- If the available job data does not reliably support an answer,
  return an empty string "".
- Do not guess.
- Do not use assumptions about the country, company or candidate.


==================================================
WORK MODE
==================================================

Allowed:

Remote
Hybrid
On-site
""

Only fill this field when the job data explicitly indicates:

Remote
Remoto
100% Remote
Hybrid
Híbrido
On-site
Onsite
Presencial

Never infer work mode from:

- city
- country
- office address
- transportation benefits
- company habits
- absence of the word Remote

If there is no explicit evidence:
""


==================================================
LANGUAGE
==================================================

Allowed:

English
Portuguese
""

Use the main language of the vacancy when clear from the
job content.

Do not infer employment type from language.


==================================================
PAYMENT
==================================================

Allowed:

Hourly
Fixed-price
Weekly
Monthly
Annual
Not specified
""

Only fill Payment when the job data explicitly supports the
payment frequency or payment model.

Examples:

per hour / hourly => Hourly
fixed price => Fixed-price
per week / weekly => Weekly
per month / monthly => Monthly
per year / annual / yearly => Annual

Do NOT infer Payment from:

- CLT
- PJ
- Full-time
- Part-time
- Contract

If no reliable evidence exists:
""


==================================================
TIME TYPE
==================================================

Allowed:

Full-time
Part-time
""

Examples:

Tempo integral => Full-time
Full-time => Full-time

Meio período => Part-time
Part-time => Part-time

IMPORTANT:

Full-time and Part-time describe TIME TYPE.

They do NOT determine Job Type.


==================================================
JOB TYPE
==================================================

Allowed values:

Contract
Internship
Freelance
Temporary
PJ
CLT
Long-term
""

Multiple values may be returned separated by comma and space
ONLY when multiple employment types are explicitly supported.

VERY IMPORTANT:

Job Type requires explicit evidence.

DO NOT infer Job Type from:

- Junior
- Senior
- Assistant / Assistente
- entry-level
- "starting your career"
- "learn in practice"
- training or mentorship
- Full-time
- Part-time
- Portuguese language
- Brazil location
- company nationality
- benefits
- permanent-looking responsibilities
- absence of another employment type

Internship:
Use ONLY when the vacancy explicitly says Internship, Intern,
Estágio, Estagiário or Estagiária.

A Junior role is NOT an Internship.

CLT:
Use ONLY when CLT is explicitly stated.

PJ:
Use ONLY when PJ or Pessoa Jurídica is explicitly stated.

Contract:
Use ONLY when Contract, Contractor or Contrato is explicitly stated.

Freelance:
Use ONLY when Freelance or Freelancer is explicitly stated.

Temporary:
Use ONLY when Temporary, Temporário or Temporária is explicitly stated.

Long-term:
Use ONLY when the job explicitly describes a long-term
engagement or long-term contract.

If employment type is not explicitly supported:
""


==================================================
EXPERIENCE
==================================================

Allowed values:

Senior
Mid
Specialist
Junior
Intern
Lead
""

IMPORTANT:

Experience is a MULTI-SELECT field.

When the vacancy explicitly covers more than one seniority level,
return multiple allowed values separated by comma and space.

Examples:

Pleno-sênior
Mid-Senior
Pleno/Sênior
Mid/Senior

=> "Mid, Senior"

Preserve the current value when already populated.

If missing, infer cautiously using:

- explicit seniority
- years requested
- responsibilities
- autonomy
- architecture ownership
- leadership scope
- complexity

Useful mappings:

Assistente / entry-level => Junior
Júnior / Junior => Junior
Pleno / Mid-level => Mid
Pleno-sênior / Mid-Senior => Mid, Senior
Sênior / Senior => Senior
Especialista / Specialist => Specialist
Lead / Tech Lead / Technical Lead => Lead
Estágio / Intern => Intern

Do NOT convert Junior into Intern unless the vacancy explicitly
identifies the role as an internship.

If multiple levels are explicitly supported, preserve all of them.


==================================================
SALARY
==================================================

Preserve the original currency and range when available.

Examples:

R$ 8.000 - R$ 10.000
USD 80,000 - 100,000
€50,000

If salary is not explicitly available:
""


==================================================
MATCH RULES
==================================================

MATCH measures ONLY technical and professional compatibility.

Allowed:

High
Medium
Low

DO NOT consider:

- Remote / Hybrid / On-site
- location
- salary
- employment model
- whether the candidate personally wants the job
- whether Qualified will later be Yeap or Nope

Match and work arrangement are completely independent.

Evaluate in this order:

1. Primary technical domain
2. Core responsibilities
3. Core technologies and skills
4. Demonstrated projects / professional experience
5. Seniority and real scope
6. Years of experience


HIGH

Use High when:

- the candidate strongly matches the primary domain;
- most core responsibilities are supported;
- several core technologies overlap;
- demonstrated experience suggests the candidate can perform
  most of the work;
- remaining gaps are mostly secondary or learnable.


MEDIUM

Use Medium when:

- the primary domain clearly matches;
- several important technologies/responsibilities overlap;
- but meaningful gaps remain in core areas, architecture,
  infrastructure, production experience or scope.

Generic example:

A candidate may match the main domain, core responsibilities,
and several important technologies, while still missing some
production infrastructure, architecture, or platform-specific
experience.

This should normally be Medium rather than automatically Low
when the overlap is still meaningful.


LOW

Use Low only when:

- the primary domain is substantially different;
- most core responsibilities are unsupported;
- overlap is superficial or peripheral;
- or there is a major demonstrated gap in actual responsibility,
  scope or seniority.

Missing several individual technologies alone is NOT enough
for Low.


==================================================
YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
==================================================

Years are supporting evidence, not a rigid filter.

A small difference between requested years and demonstrated
relevant experience should have limited impact when the CV
clearly supports the required capability.

A larger gap matters more when it also reflects a real gap in:

- responsibility
- complexity
- autonomy
- architecture
- leadership
- production experience


==================================================
CURRENT JOB DATA
==================================================

Title:
${job.title ?? ''}

Company:
${job.company_name ?? ''}

Location:
${job.location ?? ''}

Current Work Mode:
${job.work_mode ?? ''}

Current Language:
${job.language ?? ''}

Current Payment:
${job.payment ?? ''}

Current Time Type:
${job.time_type ?? ''}

Current Job Type:
${job.job_type ?? ''}

Current Experience:
${job.experience ?? ''}

Current Salary:
${job.salary ?? ''}

Description:

${description}


==================================================
CANDIDATE CV
==================================================

${cvText}


==================================================
OUTPUT
==================================================

Return ONLY valid JSON.

No markdown.
No explanation.

{
  "work_mode": "",
  "language": "",
  "payment": "",
  "time_type": "",
  "job_type": "",
  "experience": "",
  "salary": "",
  "match": "High"
}

Experience may contain multiple values, for example:

"experience": "Mid, Senior"

The match value MUST be exactly:

High
Medium
Low
`.trim();


// --------------------------------------------------
// 4. PREPARED JOB
// --------------------------------------------------

const prepared = {
  ...job,

  // Match is always recalculated by the AI.
  match: '',

  // Human-in-the-loop field.
  qualified: '',

  // Generated later by Workflow 03.
  cover_letter: '',

  ai_prompt:
    aiPrompt
};


// --------------------------------------------------
// 5. GOOGLE SHEETS A:Y
// --------------------------------------------------

prepared.row_values = [

  prepared.job_id ?? '',          // A - Job ID

  prepared.status ?? '',          // B - Status

  prepared.date_scraped ?? '',    // C - Date Scraped

  prepared.source ?? '',          // D - Source

  prepared.search_keyword ?? '',  // E - Search Keyword

  prepared.date_posted ?? '',     // F - Date Posted

  prepared.title ?? '',           // G - Title

  prepared.work_mode ?? '',       // H - Work Mode

  prepared.url ?? '',             // I - URL

  prepared.company_name ?? '',    // J - Company Name

  prepared.location ?? '',        // K - Location

  prepared.description ?? '',     // L - Description

  prepared.language ?? '',        // M - Language

  prepared.payment ?? '',         // N - Payment

  prepared.time_type ?? '',       // O - Time Type

  prepared.job_type ?? '',        // P - Job Type

  prepared.experience ?? '',      // Q - Experience

  prepared.salary ?? '',          // R - Salary

  prepared.match ?? '',           // S - Match

  prepared.qualified ?? '',       // T - Qualified

  prepared.cover_letter ?? '',    // U - Cover Letter

  prepared.notes ?? '',           // V - Notes

  prepared.interview_at ?? '',    // W - Interview At

  prepared.invite_meet ?? '',     // X - Invite Meet

  prepared.attended ?? false      // Y - Attended
];


return {
  json: prepared
};
